proof: `FY 2020 RECEIPTS - JUNE 2020`, PDF page 24 of the FY2020 annual town report. READ, NOT RECOGNISED: pdfplumber returns 1 word on this page, so there is no text layer; the page is a single JPEG2000 bitmap of 1062x1392 px (~125 dpi), printed LANDSCAPE on a portrait sheet, extracted, rotated 90 degrees upright and read at 1.9x in two halves -- every digit separates. The page has NO COLUMN HEADER: it is a banner over THREE unheaded label/amount pairs, which is why `receivables-refused.csv` says `the header could not be read; refused rather than aligned` -- a correct statement about the instrument and the wrong question to ask of this page. TWO INDEPENDENT PROOFS, both to the cent: the 100 detail lines add to the printed GRAND TOTAL of $43,089,202.54, and so, separately, do the nine SUMMARY OF RECEIPTS lines the page prints. SIX OF THE NINE CATEGORIES FOOT SEPARATELY off headings the page itself prints above their lines -- licenses and permits ($331,254.75, 19 lines), state revenue ($9,790,141.52, 12), special assessments ($68,681.50, 3), fines and forfeits ($37,182.61, 4), investment income ($102,340.41, 1) and transfers from other funds ($2,291,492.46, 1). THE OTHER THREE DO NOT, AND THAT IS A PROPERTY OF THE PAGE: TAXES & EXCISES, FEES and NON RECURRING REVENUE print no heading that separates their 60 lines from one another, and those 60 foot as ONE block to $30,468,109.29, the sum of the three printed category totals. A residual does fit -- SUPPL TAX-NEW CONSTRUCTION $10,057.81 moved out of taxes and $100,180.88 of RESCUE WAGON moved out of non-recurring would close all three -- but that is arithmetic choosing a grouping rather than the document stating one, and it is refused here (rule 14). The column is therefore named `taxes_excises_fees_non_recurring` and the split is registered as a gap.
